newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Gujing Distillery passes dividend plan.
newsitem.headline: Gujing Distillery passes dividend plan.

text.p: Shareholders of Anhui Gujing Distillery Co Ltd have approved dividend plans for the firm's A and B shares, the company said in a statement on Wednesday.

The company will make a pre-tax cash dividend of 0.21 yuan per B share and an after-tax dividend of 0.0928 yuan per A share based on 1996 profits, said the statement in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times.
The shares will go ex-dividend on June 13, it said.
The exchange rate for the B share dividend, paid in Hong Kong dollars, is based on the May 24 bank rate of 1.0717 yuan to HK$1.0, it said.
In 1996, Gujing posted net profits 169.37 million yuan, up 16.7 percent from 145.13 million in 1995 based on international accounting standards.
Turnover reached 951.97 million yuan in 1996 compared with 766.47 million the previous year under Chinese standards.
